title.title: Every contact Fano manifold is an adjoint variety
title.subtitle: Claim: every projective contact Fano manifold is homogeneous, so positive quaternion-Kähler means Wolf space

plain: A rare, very symmetric kind of curved space only comes in the textbook models, the Wolf spaces

lines.tex: Z \cong \term{a}{\text{adjoint variety of a simple Lie algebra}}

beats.text: Start from a positive quaternion-Kähler manifold $M$
Its twistor space is a contact Fano manifold
Claimed: that is always homogeneous, so $M$ is a symmetric Wolf space

achievement.label: LeBrun–Salamon conjecture (1994)
statement: M \text{ positive quaternion-K\"ahler} \;\Rightarrow\; M \text{ a Wolf space}
achievement.context: Before: known in real dimensions 8 and 12, and somewhat further by torus actions
achievement.note: Also a classification of projective contact manifolds

verify.detail: No Lean; 40 pages, a single paper
verify.ourCheck: We read the claim and caveats; we did not check the proof

voice.text: Twistor spaces give contact Fano manifolds.
Is every contact Fano manifold homogeneous?
Claimed: yes, so each such manifold is a Wolf space.

sources.quote: It was known in real dimensions 8 and 12 and pushed somewhat further by torus-action methods.
